2607.21447.title: RUMBA: Russian User Memory Benchmark
2607.21447.paper_summary: The ability to handle long-term memory in LLMs is becoming increasingly critical, yet existing benchmarks remain English-centric and rely on aggregate retrieval metrics, failing to capture interactions between long-range context, temporal information, and reasoning. To address this, we introduce RUMBA (Russian User Memory BenchmArk) - a new benchmark for long-term conversational memory that provides a fine-grained taxonomy of memory-centric question types and a unified methodology accounting for semantic type, session scope, temporal reasoning, and the explicitness of temporal expressions. RUMBA consists of timestamped user-assistant dialogues with QA pairs requiring retrieval, combination, and reasoning across sessions. While designed for Russian, we also provide an aligned English subset under the same methodology. We evaluate contemporary memory systems and long-context models, and show how RUMBA serves as a diagnostic tool to analyze model behavior across benchmark slices and identify strengths and failure modes of different memory mechanisms.
2607.21447.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶在大型語言模型（LLMs）中的處理能力變得越來越重要，但現有的基準仍然以英語為中心，並依賴於聚合檢索指標，未能捕捉長距離上下文、時間信息和推理之間的互動。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了RUMBA（俄羅斯用戶記憶基準）——一個新的長期對話記憶基準，提供了一個細緻的記憶中心問題類型分類法，以及一個統一的方法論，考慮語義類型、會話範圍、時間推理和時間表達的明確性。RUMBA由帶有時間戳的用戶-助手對話組成，這些對話包含需要在會話之間進行檢索、組合和推理的問答對。雖然是為俄語設計的，我們也提供了在相同方法論下對應的英語子集。我們評估當代記憶系統和長上下文模型，並展示RUMBA如何作為診斷工具來分析模型在基準切片中的行為，並識別不同記憶機制的優勢和失敗模式。
